title: 第3517章 三步仙帝果真难杀第3516章 我也给你一个机会
content_zh:
“万物寂灭！”
苏尘双掌并拢，朝着前方凌空一指。
一道极为恐怖的湮灭光波骤然凝聚而出，朝着光耀仙帝激射而来！
光耀仙帝当即抬手一档，瞬间凝聚出一道金光护盾，竟将那道湮灭光波硬生生抵挡下来！
就在这时。
一道道仙金触手，忽然从四面八方激射而来，如蛇如龙，朝着他的身躯缠绕而去！
与此同时，一团诡异黑雾，凭空出现，瞬间将他身影笼罩！
嗡！
光耀仙帝的身影忽然剧烈一震，瞬间分化万千，朝着四面八方激射而去！
虽然其中绝大多数，都被那些仙金触手刺爆或者缠绕起来，但是没有一个是他本体！
“吞噬！”
不灭真我暴吼一声，再度祭出不朽光轮，化作一个宇宙黑洞，释放出极为恐怖的吞噬之力！
霎时间！
光耀仙帝刚刚分化出来的万千身影，纷纷都被吸入那个宇宙黑洞当中！
其中一个光耀仙帝身形一闪，骤然出现在苏尘身后，双手当中凝聚出一团极为恐怖的能量漩涡，直接朝着苏尘本体投掷过去！
苏尘心有所感，立马身形暴退。
同时转身，双手紧握太初无极剑，并将“幻灭”
的力量，充斥其内！
轰！
太初无极剑重重斩在那团能量漩涡之上，发出一声震天巨响！

“幻灭”
的力量，加持在太初无极剑之上，居然只将那团能量漩涡的威能抵消一半！
还剩下一半力量，终究还是落在了苏尘身上！
“嘭”
的一声。
他的肉身当即炸开，暴露出他的修炼核心，一枚庞大无比的大道真名！
“本帝刚才说了，谁杀谁还说不定呢！”
光耀仙帝冷哼一声，手心当中再度凝聚出一团更加恐怖的能量漩涡，朝着苏尘的大道真名轰击而去！
三大真我见状，纷纷瞳孔骤缩！
根据刚才那一击的威力，他们绝不怀疑，对方那团能量漩涡，绝对能够重创苏尘的大道真名！
想到这一点，三大真我纷纷身形一闪，挡在本体的大道真名之前。
然后各自竭尽全力，同时施展出一招“幻灭”
，迎向那团能量漩涡！
与此同时！
周围一道道仙帝虚影，瞬间化作一道道流光，铺天盖地，朝着光耀仙帝的方向疯狂激射而去！
content_en:
"All things are destroyed!"
Su Chen put his palms together and pointed forward in the air.
An extremely terrifying wave of annihilation light suddenly condensed and shot towards the Emperor Guangyao!
Immortal Emperor Guangyao immediately raised his hand and instantly condensed a golden shield, which blocked the annihilation light wave!
Just then.
Immortal gold tentacles suddenly shot out from all directions, like snakes and dragons, winding towards his body!
At the same time, a strange black mist appeared out of thin air, instantly covering his figure!
Buzz!
The figure of the Emperor Guangyao suddenly shook violently, split into thousands of parts in an instant, and shot out in all directions!
Although most of them were stabbed or entangled by those fairy gold tentacles, none of them were his true form!
"Swallow!"
The immortal true self roared violently, and once again sacrificed the immortal light wheel, turning it into a cosmic black hole, releasing extremely terrifying devouring power!
All of a sudden!
The thousands of figures that Emperor Guangyao had just differentiated were all sucked into the black hole of the universe!
One of the Radiant Immortal Emperors flashed and suddenly appeared behind Su Chen. An extremely terrifying energy vortex condensed in his hands and was thrown directly towards Su Chen's body!
Su Chen felt something in his heart and immediately retreated.
At the same time, he turned around, holding the Taichu Wuji Sword tightly with both hands, and "disillusioned"
The power fills it!
boom!
The Taichu Wuji Sword slashed hard on the energy vortex, making a loud noise!
"Disillusionment"
The power of the Taichu Wuji Sword was only able to offset half of the power of the energy vortex!
The remaining half of the power fell on Su Chen after all!
"Bang"
A sound.
His physical body immediately exploded, exposing the core of his cultivation, a huge Dao True Name!
"This emperor just said that we still don't know who will kill whom!"
Immortal Emperor Guangyao snorted coldly, and a more terrifying energy vortex once again condensed in the palm of his hand, blasting towards Su Chen's true name!
When the three true selves saw this, their pupils shrank suddenly!
Based on the power of the blow just now, they had no doubt that the opponent's energy vortex could definitely severely damage Su Chen's Dao True Name!
Thinking of this, the three true selves flashed and stood in front of the main body's true name.
Then each of them tried their best and used the move "Disillusionment" at the same time.
, facing that energy vortex!
at the same time!
The phantoms of the Immortal Emperor around him instantly turned into streams of light, overwhelming the sky and the earth, shooting wildly in the direction of the Guangyao Immortal Emperor!
